narrative_purpose: Depicts Pandora's founding catastrophe: a Mars-sized body striking the young molten moon inside Polyphemus's magnetic field - the event canon says disrupted the core and forged unobtanium, and that a zircon's rim would later date.
subject: A young half-molten moon seen from space, its dark crust cracked by a web of glowing orange lava seams, just struck off-center by a smaller dark rocky world. A great plume of incandescent ejecta arcs up from the impact point into space. Behind and around, the colossal banded bulk of a gas giant fills one side of the frame, and faint luminous curved lines of its magnetic field sweep around the molten moon.
scene: Deep space billions of years ago, the violent moment of collision, the gas giant looming as a cool wall behind the fiery young moon.
camera: Wide dramatic space view, the molten moon center-frame, the impactor and ejecta plume to one side, the giant planet's curve filling a background edge.
light: Fierce warm orange-amber key from the molten seams and the impact flash, cool indigo space and dim planet bands behind, a faint cyan sheen on the magnetic field lines.
palette: Mostly cool void-indigo space and dim cream-rust planet, with a deliberate hot burst of ember-amber and orange at the impact and lava seams, faint cyan field lines.
style: Painterly astronomical plate, dramatic but naturalistic, textured molten rock.
detail_level: Crisp glowing lava seams and the ejecta plume; the gas giant softer and atmospheric; field lines faint and delicate.
composition: Molten moon dominant center-left, impactor and bright plume upper-right on a diagonal of energy, gas giant anchoring the right edge, magnetic field lines curving the eye around.
consistency_notes: The banded gas giant is Polyphemus and must match its look elsewhere in the chapter (cream/rust/grey bands). Warm impact glow is the rare deliberate warm accent against the cool palette.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no dotted orbit lines, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style
